skymen_save_manager.name: Save Manager
skymen_save_manager.description: A plugin to manage JSON based save files

autoLoad.name: Auto load
autoLoad.desc: Load the save before the project starts, so the data is ready when the first layout begins

method.name: Method
method.desc: Where the save is stored. Auto picks the best available backend at runtime

jsonObject.name: JSON object
jsonObject.desc: The JSON object this plugin loads into and saves from

defaultData.name: Default data
defaultData.desc: Optional project file holding the default save data. Loaded first, then the stored save is merged on top

saveName.name: Save name
saveName.desc: Name for the save, without the extension. Leave blank to use this object's name, but note that renaming the object then hides existing saves

extension.name: Extension
extension.desc: File extension for the save. The file is named after this object type, e.g. PlayerSave.sav

folder.name: Folder
folder.desc: Which common folder file based backends write to. Ignored by local storage and custom

subfolder.name: Subfolder
subfolder.desc: Subfolder inside the chosen folder. Leave blank to use the project name

customHandlerId.name: Custom handler ID
customHandlerId.desc: Name the handler was registered under via globalThis.SaveManager.register(). Only used when Method is Custom

RevealSave.description: Open the folder containing the save in the operating system's file manager. Only works on backends that store real files

CheckSaveExists.description: Ask the backend whether a save exists, then read the result with the Has save data condition

DeleteSave.description: Remove the stored save from the selected backend. The JSON object is left as is

Load.description: Load the default data, then merge the stored save on top of it, into the JSON object

NewSave.description: Load only the default data into the JSON object. Nothing is written until you use Save

Save.description: Write the JSON object's current contents to the selected backend

OnAnyError.description: Triggered when any load, save, delete or check fails. Read LastError for the message and LastErrorOperation for which operation it was

OnCheckError.description: Triggered when Check if save exists fails

OnDeleteError.description: Triggered when deleting the save fails

OnLoadError.description: Triggered when a load fails. The default data is still applied so the game is playable, and the previous save has been backed up where the backend allows it

OnNewSaveError.description: Triggered when starting a new save fails, which means the default data could not be read

OnRevealError.description: Triggered when revealing the save location fails, which usually means the backend has no folder to open

OnSaveError.description: Triggered when a save fails. Nothing was written, so the stored save is unchanged

IsUsingBackend.description: Check which backend was actually resolved, which is useful when Method is Auto

HasSaveData.description: True if the last load or check found an existing save. Conditions cannot do IO, so use Check if save exists first to refresh this

IsLoaded.description: True once data has been loaded into the JSON object at least once

OnDeleted.description: Triggered after the stored save has been deleted

OnLoaded.description: Triggered after save data has been loaded and merged into the JSON object

OnNewSave.description: Triggered after a new save has been started from the default data

OnSaveChecked.description: Triggered after Check if save exists finishes

OnSaved.description: Triggered after save data has been written successfully

LastError.description: The message from the most recent failure, or an empty string if the last operation succeeded

LastErrorOperation.description: Which operation the last error came from: "load", "save", "delete" or "check". Empty if the last operation succeeded

Backend.description: The backend actually in use: localstorage, nodejs, webview, pipelab or custom. Empty until the first operation resolves one

SaveName.description: The resolved save file name, which is this object type's name plus the extension. Also the local storage key

SavePath.description: The path the save is written to for file based backends. Empty for local storage and custom backends

SaveRelativePath.description: The save's path from the selected folder down, e.g. MyGame/PlayerSave.sav. Pass this to the File System plugin along with a picker tag
